events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

events.name: UEFA Nations League Live
events.description: Spain v England (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match in Group A3, held at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid. The teams last met in the opening round of fixtures in September, when world champions Spain fought back from 2-1 down to claim a 3-2 win at Wembley Stadium. It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. With commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, and reports by Gabriel Clarke

events.name: UEFA Nations League Live
events.description: England v Croatia (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' fifth and penultimate Group A3 match, held at Wembley Stadium. England produced a stunning display to win the reverse fixture 7-0 in Rijeka, with braces by Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka and strikes from Jude Bellingham, Anthony Gordon and Morgan Rogers subjecting the Croatians to their heaviest ever defeat. England are all but certain of a place in the quarter-finals, but their opponents will be determined to restore some pride this evening and boost their chances of avoiding relegation to League B. With analysis by Roy Keane and Ian Wright, commentary from Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and interviews by reporter Gabriel Clarke

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

events.name: Nations Championship
events.description: Wales v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wales have not defeated the All Blacks since 1953, with New Zealand winning 34 consecutive matches against them since then. The last meeting between the sides came here 12 months ago, when the visitors scored seven tries in a 52-26 triumph. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams, and Jamie Roberts, with analysis by Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton, and Dan Biggar

events.name: UEFA Nations League Live
events.description: Spain v England (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match in Group A3, held at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid. The teams last met in the opening round of fixtures in September, when world champions Spain fought back from 2-1 down to claim a 3-2 win at Wembley Stadium. It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. With commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, and reports by Gabriel Clarke

events.name: UEFA Nations League Live
events.description: England v Croatia (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' fifth and penultimate Group A3 match, held at Wembley Stadium. England produced a stunning display to win the reverse fixture 7-0 in Rijeka, with braces by Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka and strikes from Jude Bellingham, Anthony Gordon and Morgan Rogers subjecting the Croatians to their heaviest ever defeat. England are all but certain of a place in the quarter-finals, but their opponents will be determined to restore some pride this evening and boost their chances of avoiding relegation to League B. With analysis by Roy Keane and Ian Wright, commentary from Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and interviews by reporter Gabriel Clarke

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

events.name: Nations Championship
events.description: Wales v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wales have not defeated the All Blacks since 1953, with New Zealand winning 34 consecutive matches against them since then. The last meeting between the sides came here 12 months ago, when the visitors scored seven tries in a 52-26 triumph. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams, and Jamie Roberts, with analysis by Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton, and Dan Biggar

events.name: UEFA Nations League Live
events.description: Spain v England (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match in Group A3, held at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid. The teams last met in the opening round of fixtures in September, when world champions Spain fought back from 2-1 down to claim a 3-2 win at Wembley Stadium. It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. With commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, and reports by Gabriel Clarke

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

events.description: Scotland v Australia (Kick-off 3.10pm). Jill Douglas presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Scottish Gas Murrayfield. events.name: UEFA Nations League Live
events.description: Spain v England (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match in Group A3, held at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid. The teams last met in the opening round of fixtures in September, when world champions Spain fought back from 2-1 down to claim a 3-2 win at Wembley Stadium. It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. With commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, and reports by Gabriel Clarke

In the early hours of February 11, 2022, 21-year-olds Saqib Hussain and Hashim Ijazuddin were found dead in a burning car on the A46 in Leicestershire. Within a short time, police arrested 22-year-old TikTok influencer Mahek Bukhari and her 45-year-old mother Ansreen, who it turned out had been in a secret relationship with Saqib that began when he was just 18

events.name: Sort Your Life Out with Stacey Solomon
events.description: Stacey helps the Viney family declutter their home after grandma Sue filled their house with her deceased mum's belongings and the contents of a recently closed gift shop. Sue's children are desperate for a clear out so they can come over and spend more time with her. The team remove everything from the house including 532 plastic carrier bags, 205 hair rollers, 30 umbrellas, 17 digital cameras and 443 pairs of shoes. While the family sort through what they want to keep, recycle, donate or sell, carpenter Rob installs a pulldown bed for extra space and Dilly reinstates the downstairs as a functioning living and dining space

events.name: The Antiques Yard
events.description: Antiques and reclamation yard-owner Daniel Dawson-Gordon and his team as reclaim, restore and repair items - bringing the unloved back to life and selling them to new homes. events.description: Documentary about the Lake District Mountain Rescue Association. Miles from the nearest road, the challenge of how to transport him to a hospital is a dilemma for team leader John

events.name: Sort Your Life Out with Stacey Solomon
events.description: Stacey helps the Viney family declutter their home after grandma Sue filled their house with her deceased mum's belongings and the contents of a recently closed gift shop. Sue's children are desperate for a clear out so they can come over and spend more time with her. The team remove everything from the house including 532 plastic carrier bags, 205 hair rollers, 30 umbrellas, 17 digital cameras and 443 pairs of shoes. While the family sort through what they want to keep, recycle, donate or sell, carpenter Rob installs a pulldown bed for extra space and Dilly reinstates the downstairs as a functioning living and dining space

events.name: The Antiques Yard
events.description: Antiques and reclamation yard-owner Daniel Dawson-Gordon and his team as reclaim, restore and repair items - bringing the unloved back to life and selling them to new homes. Daniel visits a maritime salvage yard, where he buys a desk used by Queen Mary in 1911 aboard the HMS Medina. His painting research hits a bump as a leading valuer admits she cannot put a price on Antonietta Gonzalez as she cannot be seen. All concerned hope a high-tech and rarely available scan will reveal her in all her colourful glory

events.name: Lake District Rescue
events.description: Documentary about the Lake District Mountain Rescue Association. From paragliders crashing into the mountainside, to scramblers who have fallen down waterfalls or adventurers becoming lost in the tunnel systems of disused quarries, the volunteers will drop everything to head out to the hills and bring home the lost, injured and stricken. In this episode, the team is dispatched to help a man with a dislocated shoulder at the popular Eskdale Pools. Miles from the nearest road, the challenge of how to transport him to a hospital is a dilemma for team leader John

New DS Charlie Zailer finds herself working with DC Simon Waterhouse for the first time when Geraldine Bretherick and her five-year-old daughter Lucy are found dead in the bathroom of their luxury home, and the two argue about whether the case is one of murder, suicide or something more sinister. Meanwhile, a woman tells her best friend she had an affair with Bretherick's husband and wants to see him again. Thriller, based on the novel Point of Rescue by Sophie Hannah, starring Olivia Williams, Darren Boyd, Rupert Graves and Amy Beth Hayes

events.name: Where Angels Fear to Tread
events.description: A wealthy widow travels to Italy to escape the pressure of her in-laws, and promptly falls in love with a poor local. When the revived woman agrees to marry her foreign friend, her relatives back home are shocked by the apparent disregard for class, culture and their family's image, and set about putting an end to the unlikely union. Period drama, based on the novel by EM Forster, starring Helena Bonham Carter, Judy Davis and Rupert Graves.
